text: SUFAL employs impact-based forecasting to translate hydrological and meteorological forecasts into expected local impacts, improving relevance for communities and decision-makers. It supports the FFWC in generating localized flood forecasts with extended lead times and provides real-time lightning alerts. The initiative also involves risk mapping and localization, setting thresholds and triggers for anticipatory measures, and developing early action protocols.

metadata.solution_name: Supporting Flood Forecast-Based Action and Learning in Bangladesh (SUFAL), Phase I and Phase II
